name: automix-light
description: automix's light edition — an md-only plugin for beginners. Build a spec through an interview, then implement fast and accurately.

plugins.name: aml
plugins.description: Beginner 3-step workflow: /aml:new (interview → spec.md/task.md) → /aml:go (implement + verify → progress.md) → /aml:status (check progress). Includes /aml:doctor (checks). md-first — one observability script (observe.py) logs per-task metrics to progress.md and optionally exports to Langfuse.
